title: A note on hypergraphs with asymmetric Ramsey properties
summary: Let $r,\ell\geq2$ be integers. Given $r$-graphs $G$ and $F_1,\dots,F_\ell$, we write $G\to(F_1,\dots,F_\ell)$ if every $\ell$-edge-coloring of $G$ yields a monochromatic copy of $F_i$ in the $i$th color for some $1\leq i\leq\ell$, otherwise we write $G\not\to(F_1,\dots,F_\ell)$. The Ramsey number $R(F_1,\dots,F_\ell)$ is the minimum number of vertices in an $r$-graph $G$ satisfying $G\to(F_1,\dots,F_\ell)$.
